title: Filter countries by substring
description: Write a function `filter_containing(countries, substring)` that returns the countries whose name contains `substring`, using `filter()`.
hints: Function to consider: filter(), with a lambda checking membership
filter(lambda c: substring in c, countries) keeps only the items where the lambda returns True - filter(), unlike map(), drops items rather than transforming them.
Return list(filter(lambda c: substring in c, countries)).
expected_behavior: Returns the countries containing substring, in the original order.
solution:
def filter_containing(countries, substring):
    return list(filter(lambda c: substring in c, countries))
explanation: filter()'s callback answers a yes/no question per item - items where it's True are kept, items where it's False are dropped, which is the opposite of map()'s 'transform every item.'
